mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM requirements WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at = 0 GROUP BY status

SELECT rt.name AS type, COUNT(r.id) AS count FROM requirement_types rt LEFT JOIN requirements r ON r.type = rt.code AND r.project_id = #{projectId} AND r.deleted_at = 0 GROUP BY rt.id, rt.name, rt.sort_order ORDER BY MIN(COALESCE(rt.sort_order, 999))
SELECT priority, COUNT(*) as count FROM requirements WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at = 0 GROUP BY priority

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FROM requirements r WHERE r.deleted_at = 0 AND (r.is_draft = 0 OR r.is_draft IS NULL) AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles ro ON ur.role_id = ro.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ro.code = 'SUPER_ADMIN') OR r.creator_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_instance_transitions wit WHERE wit.requirement_id = r.id AND wit.operator_id = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_instances wi JOIN workflow_nodes wn ON wi.workflow_version_id = wn.workflow_version_id AND wi.current_node_id = wn.node_id WHERE wi.requirement_id = r.id AND JSON_CONTAINS(wn.assignee_user_ids, CAST(#{userId} AS JSON))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_organizations uo WHERE uo.user_id = #{userId} AND uo.org_id = r.org_id) )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FROM requirements r WHERE r.deleted_at = 0 AND (r.is_draft = 0 OR r.is_draft IS NULL) AND r.node_status = 'IN_DEVELOPMENT' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles ro ON ur.role_id = ro.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ro.code = 'SUPER_ADMIN') OR r.creator_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_instance_transitions wit WHERE wit.requirement_id = r.id AND wit.operator_id = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_instances wi JOIN workflow_nodes wn ON wi.workflow_version_id = wn.workflow_version_id AND wi.current_node_id = wn.node_id WHERE wi.requirement_id = r.id AND JSON_CONTAINS(wn.assignee_user_ids, CAST(#{userId} AS JSON))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_organizations uo WHERE uo.user_id = #{userId} AND uo.org_id = r.org_id) )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FROM requirements r WHERE r.deleted_at = 0 AND (r.is_draft = 0 OR r.is_draft IS NULL) AND r.node_status = 'ACCEPTED' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles ro ON ur.role_id = ro.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ro.code = 'SUPER_ADMIN') OR r.creator_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_instance_transitions wit WHERE wit.requirement_id = r.id AND wit.operator_id = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_instances wi JOIN workflow_nodes wn ON wi.workflow_version_id = wn.workflow_version_id AND wi.current_node_id = wn.node_id WHERE wi.requirement_id = r.id AND JSON_CONTAINS(wn.assignee_user_ids, CAST(#{userId} AS JSON))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_organizations uo WHERE uo.user_id = #{userId} AND uo.org_id = r.org_id) )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FROM requirements r WHERE r.deleted_at = 0 AND (r.is_draft = 0 OR r.is_draft IS NULL) AND r.node_status != 'ACCEPTED' AND r.due_date IS NOT NULL AND r.due_date < CURDATE() AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles ro ON ur.role_id = ro.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ro.code = 'SUPER_ADMIN') OR r.creator_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_instance_transitions wit WHERE wit.requirement_id = r.id AND wit.operator_id = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_instances wi JOIN workflow_nodes wn ON wi.workflow_version_id = wn.workflow_version_id AND wi.current_node_id = wn.node_id WHERE wi.requirement_id = r.id AND JSON_CONTAINS(wn.assignee_user_ids, CAST(#{userId} AS JSON))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_organizations uo WHERE uo.user_id = #{userId} AND uo.org_id = r.org_id) )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requirements WHERE assignee_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at = 0 AND status NOT IN ('已上线','已验收','已取消')
SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM requirements WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at = 0 GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT status, AVG(DATEDIFF(updated_at, created_at)) as avg_days, MAX(DATEDIFF(updated_at, created_at)) as max_days, MIN(DATEDIFF(updated_at, created_at)) as min_days FROM requirements WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at = 0 GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('已上线','已验收') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed FROM requirements WHERE iteration_id = #{iterationId} AND deleted_at = 0 GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date
SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, status, COUNT(*) as count FROM requirements WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at = 0 GROUP BY DATE(created_at), status ORDER BY date

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wit.requirement_id) FROM workflow_instance_transitions wit JOIN requirements r ON wit.requirement_id = r.id WHERE wit.operator_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted_at = 0 AND (r.is_draft = 0 OR r.is_draft IS NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requirements WHERE creator_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at = 0 AND (is_draft = 0 OR is_draft IS NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requirements WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND (is_draft = 0 OR is_draft IS NULL) AND cc_user_ids IS NOT NULL AND JSON_CONTAINS(cc_user_ids, CAST(#{userId} AS JSON))
